# orchard_service_account (Data Source)

Retrieves a specific service account or all service accounts. If `name` is omitted, returns all.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "orchard" {
  token    = "your-service-account-token"
  base_url = "http://localhost:8080"
}

data "orchard_service_account" "all" {}

output "account_names" {
  value = data.orchard_service_account.all.service_accounts[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the service account. If omitted, returns all.

### Read-Only

- `service_accounts` (List of Object) (see [below](#nestedatt--service_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--service_accounts"></a>
The `service_accounts` block contains:

- `name` (String)
- `roles` (List of String)
- `token` (String, Sensitive)
